capabilities: Browse and change built-in Obsidian CSS variables
Write toggleable CSS rules in a code editor with syntax highlighting and Prettier
Pick page elements visually to start rules from real selectors
Import fonts as @font-face rules and reuse existing CSS snippets
Export theme.css and manifest.json and back up settings to a vault file
disambiguation: Not a theme installer or gallery; it creates and edits your own themes rather than distributing existing ones.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later on a desktop device; detailed usage lives in a separate user guide.
intentEvidence: Build your own Obsidian theme from inside Obsidian.
problem: Creating a full theme normally means writing theme.css and manifest.json by hand outside Obsidian, with no way to inspect selectors or preview changes as you type.
